content: Iesu Iyau Tafaror Goa arimon Intagogoros Insur
Iesu tafaror goa ibikirir ato an baigibubunuotin tani on iyau, “Baibebeotim eite, agim gagamis obis maiau a goa obis obis maiau siyonen!”
Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Om atonio osi goa gagamis eiten? Men agim tani arimon nin an efanai inen on, arimon engon tutufin sinifufusas sinsawaris.”
Yawas Wawanis a Baikokosar
Iesu on Olive Oyau on tefanai nan imair imama, tafaror goa reban emon, ato Peter, James, John a Andrew on bubuniai sinai aurin.
Osi sitetemai siyau, “Om ekasonei atonio osi bobo on arimon meyan sinmatar a ekasonei bobo aifan arimon inmatar onai iniyoboei wansagob on wera inat atonio osi bobo engon tutufin sinmatar.”
Iesu osi auris iyau, “Omi matam woneit, men woniyamai iyafan tani inisigoem mes.
Sabu sigaraba arimon sinnat Yau Wabiui sinau sinikakafun, arimon sinnat sinau, ‘Yau on orot atonio!’ ato osi arimon sabu sinisigoes.

Ato sabu sinbigagam fonas auwatin wontatam a tafanam nanenei sinbigagam duras wat wontatam on men woniyababan mes. Atonio osi bobo nanaba on arimon sinmatar, baise osi bobo on men sebiyamai ra kanfoun inat igat on.

Tafanam arimon tous wat sinigagam bonen; baiaiwab arimon tous wat sinigagam bonen, uruyoi arimon tafanam au engon inboai, a gomar an ra innat. Atonio osi bobo engon tutufin on jever koun ebosuruf egigiai usibaban eboai toub aurin mes ba.

Iesu iyau, “Omi toum mat on matam woneit. Omi arimon sinfatumem ato sinboem wonan sinigrubabanim. Omi arimon bayoi goai nan sinborarabim; omi arimon Yau fasiui on bainetewarotis a aiwabis nasi wontawar Yau Wabiui au Wasagobin on osi sabu auris wonkurereb.
Omi on arimon wasagobin wonkurereb sabu engon tutufin auris weie ra kanfoun innat ingat.

Ato omi sinfatumem sinboem wonan baigurubabanotin aurin on, men woniyababan dura mamaba wonbikakafun aurin on, ato wera innat on dura aifan God inbibitetem on asir wonau mom. Yabin dura ato wonbikakafun on men omi ami dura on; ato osi dura on arimon Ayu Kakafotin emon sinnat.

Sabu arimon tous taitais tutuas on sabu imasi sinyagaiis ato sinasububunues a fifirig tatamas on arimon on eta kaitamomai nanaba nanatus auris sinafour. Fifirig arimon tatamas auris siniragites ato sabu fani sinawures sinasububunues.
Yau fasiui on sabu engon tutufin arimon sinisisiweiim. Baise iyai iyafan nana infaskikin inan au kanfoun ingat on arimon inyawas.”
Beruber Komasin

Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Omi arimon sawar ‘Beruber Komasin’ ato yawas engon ebikomasen on tafaror goa amonai intatawar wonitai!” (Om baiyabotim: atonio dura ebiyab on an yabin unsagob!) Namon osi sabu iyabon Judea tafanam amonai semama on au oyau siniyai sinan.
Orot iyafan an goa uwayob tefanai on men an wera inisawarai insur goa amonai an sawar aifan nan sen on inboen inan mes.
Orot iyafan masauai ebobo on men inmatabir inan an goai nan an beber inboai mes.
On an rai jever yas sisag aumas a jever nanatus susus aumas, osi auris on komasin bag!
God aurin wonbayoi atonio bobo on men arimon yabat yawarad an rai nan sinmatar mes!

Yabin on an rai yawas wawanis on arimon sinkomas kwakwan, men ato tafanamai bobo simamatar ba, ainau anai bag God tafanam ifofourai inat ari i’gat nan. Ato gibui yawas wawanis on arimon men nanaba sinmatar men.
Baise Bada on ra idibonai nono; On bobo men on nanaba itfofour on, men iyafan tani nana yawasin itama on. Yabin On an sabu rurubinis auris on mes On ra idibonai.
“Namon iyai iyafan inawurem inau, ‘Eite Keriso atonio!’ o ‘Eite on min ato!’—omi men wonitutumai mes.
Yabin baisigogo Keriso a baisigogo aubairuruotis fani on arimon sinrobotet. Osi arimon bobo buburis a bobo baiduduranis sinfouren God an sabu rurubinis sinisigoes.
Omi matam woneit! Yau atonio dura engon tutufin ainau awurem weie bobo sinmatar.”
Orot Natun Innat
Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “On an rai yawas wawanis insawar gibunai wera arimon inwoman, roke arimon men intagawai men,
siribod arimon kasakasau emon sinafeu, safamai sawar faiwaris sen on arimon asi efan sinisararen.
Namon Orot Natun kasakasauai inrobotet, an faiwar gagamin a an kudidirin gagaminai innat.
On arimon anea iniyafares singat tafanam au engonai nan God an sabu rurubinis semama on sinruayois.”
Bubudau Wengar on Iniyoboet
Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Bubudau wengar on inibebeyim. On an rai fafamen ebiyamai enat rifuis a nunubas semamatar on, rorous sibosuruf seyaya on wonsagob kwanda an ra on inat ebiufin.
On eta kaitamomai omi atonio osi bobo woniten sinmamatar on wonsagob an wera inat ebiufin, ebotitiwag inbosuruf mes.
Omi wononosin, atonio osi bobo engon tutufin sinmatar weie sabu ari nin semama on engon sinarab.
Safam tafanam on arimon sintumai baise Yau au dura on arimon men meyan intumai on.”
Men Iyafan Tani Ra o Wera Isagob
Iesu an dura nana ikakafun iyau, “Baise men iyafan tani isagob meyan ato ra o wera innat-anea safamai semama on men sisagob a Natun mat men isagob; God Taman ekesin mom isagob.
Omi matam woneit, usim sinisas yabin On an wera meyan innat on omi men wosagob.
On arimon ato orot ba, an goa ebikirir ebinanawan ato an agirotis ebikirires an goa sekakaifarai, on kakaita kakaita asi bobo ebites ato gibui metewan awan kaifarotin yawur nana inkakaifar.
On mes omi wonkaifar yabin omi men wosagob meyan goa matuanin enat- arimon rabirabi, o fom nub basun o fomenei o ra an womanai o wera egeg nan.
On ingat safurem ato men ibasit omi ingaturem on woenbubur.
Yau mamaba awurem on min nanaba sabu engon tutufin aurim abikakafun. Omi wonkaifar!”
